method: pair level: external error = a related pair split at LCA depth <= 1 (false split) or an unrelated pair joined deep (LCA depth >= 2 and >= the run's deep threshold or either item's class depth; false join); AUC of the variant's pair score and kappa of its flag against that error, pooled over the universe's runs, on the MiniLM graph with 200 replicates. Scheme level: the external separation of a run is the AUC with which a smaller meeting class (|leaves(LCA)|) picks related over unrelated pairs; Spearman rho across runs between it and minus the variant's run value, for each model. 1000 replicates: pairs resampled within related/unrelated (one resample stream per signal, shared by every run and model), run values from the same-index paired item-bootstrap draw.
